## Verdict

Docs are lightly bash-biased mostly via ` ```bash ` fences. Real Unix-shell assumptions are few: AGENTS.md pipe recipes, one proposed hook with `&&`/`||`/`echo`, and (adjacent) `rm -rf` in `package.json`. No CONTRIBUTING/SETUP, no `.cursor/` rules/hooks, no `*.sh`.

---

### High impact (Unix shell semantics)

**`C:\Users\graff\WebstormProjects\rule-validator\AGENTS.md`**

```bash
bv --robot-triage --format toon | toon -d   # Full triage: priority, health, quick wins
bv --robot-next --format toon | toon -d     # Single top pick
bv --robot-insights --format toon | toon -d # Graph metrics + cycle detection
bv --robot-plan --format toon | toon -d     # Parallel execution tracks
```

Prose:

> Pipe any `--robot-*` output through `toon -d` to decode token-efficient format back to JSON.  
> Add `--format toon` to bv commands; pipe to `toon -d` before passing to tools.

**Alt:** Keep pipes (PowerShell pipes external tools too). Prefer fence `shell` not `bash`. Or two-step:

- Bash/POSIX: `bv ... | toon -d`
- PowerShell: `bv ... | toon -d` (same) / or `bv ... | Out-String | toon -d` if encoding bites
- Avoid documenting bash-only `#` reliance; ok in both shells

**`C:\Users\graff\WebstormProjects\rule-validator\docs\distillation-2026-03-11T18-00-00.md`**

```json
"command": "git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || echo 'WARNING: uncommitted changes present — commit before dispatching worktree subagent'"
```

**Alt:** Bun/Node one-liner, or PowerShell:
`if (-not ((git diff --quiet) -and (git diff --cached --quiet))) { Write-Output 'WARNING: ...' }`  
Or: `bun -e "…"` so the hook is shell-agnostic.
